description: Horizontal timeline view with resource rows and 24-hour time slots. An event renders as a tinted card with a coloured left stripe. A host EventTemplate renders directly into the card, so a multi-line template is not clipped; the built-in time and title are direct children of the card and each ellipsizes on its own. span.tm-scheduler-event-content is a host opt-in ellipsis (the same rule exists on the time-grid card), and the resize handles stay outside the template. Supports drag-and-drop event moving across resources and bidirectional resize handles via JS interop. Accessibility: the rows form a grid (one row header and one cell per resource), and the slots inside each cell share one roving tab stop (Left/Right a slot, Up/Down a resource). A keyboard context menu opens on the slot itself. An EventTemplate must not contain its own focusable element. Scale="Days" renders the days of the range instead of the hour slots of one day: a sticky resource column, one day column per date (FirstDayOfWeek/WeekDays), a chip per event with the localized time and title (or EventTemplate), lanes for overlapping events in one day, the MaxVisibleEvents cap with the plural TmScheduler_More button (OnMoreClick), and the day/keyboard move path. Event times print a full and a compact reading and the stylesheet picks by the card's width.

parameters.name: CurrentDate
parameters.description: Currently displayed date.

parameters.name: Resources
parameters.description: Resources to display as rows.

parameters.name: Events
parameters.description: Events to display.

parameters.name: SlotDuration
parameters.description: Duration of each time slot in minutes.

parameters.name: OnSlotClick
parameters.description: Fires when a time slot is clicked.

parameters.name: SelectedEvent
parameters.description: The selected event. The matching bar gets aria-current and tm-scheduler-timeline-event--selected.

parameters.name: SelectedEventChanged
parameters.description: Fires when the user selects an event.

parameters.name: OnEventClick
parameters.description: Fires when an event is clicked.

parameters.name: ReadOnly
parameters.description: Whether events are read-only.

parameters.name: WorkDayStart
parameters.description: First minute of the working day. With ShowFullDay false it is the first rendered hour.

parameters.name: WorkDayEnd
parameters.description: Last minute of the working day.

parameters.name: ShowFullDay
parameters.description: When false the timeline shows only the working hours. Default true.

parameters.name: HighlightOffHours
parameters.description: When true, hours outside the working day are tinted. Default false.

parameters.name: ScrollToTime
parameters.description: When set, the timeline scrolls this time into view after the first render. Null does not scroll.

parameters.name: ShowNowIndicator
parameters.description: When true the current day draws the current-time indicator. Default true.

parameters.name: TimeZone
parameters.description: Display zone for the current-time indicator.

parameters.name: ResourceHeaderTemplate
parameters.description: Replaces the default resource header.

parameters.name: OnEventChanged
parameters.description: Fires when an event changes.

parameters.name: OnAnnounced
parameters.description: Fires with the sentence a move or a resize should announce. The scheduler owns the one live region.

parameters.name: OnSlotContextMenu
parameters.description: Fires when right-clicking on a time slot.

parameters.name: OnEventContextMenu
parameters.description: Fires when right-clicking on an event.

parameters.name: EventTemplate
parameters.description: Optional custom event renderer used inside each positioned timeline bar. The bar's positioning and resize handles stay; only the inner content is replaced.

parameters.name: Scale
parameters.description: How the columns are laid out: the hour slots of CurrentDate (the default) or the days of the range with one row per resource.

parameters.name: FirstDayOfWeek
parameters.description: The day the day columns start on. 0 is Sunday, 1 (the default) Monday. Used only by the day scale.

parameters.name: WeekDays
parameters.description: Which days the day columns show. WorkWeek drops the weekend. Used only by the day scale.

parameters.name: MaxVisibleEvents
parameters.description: The chip cap of one day cell; the overflow becomes the localized "+N more" button that raises OnMoreClick.

parameters.name: OnMoreClick
parameters.description: Fires when the "+N more" button of a day cell is pressed, with that day.

parameters.name: Today
parameters.description: The day the day columns mark as today. The default marks no column.

parameters.name: SelectedDate
parameters.description: The selected day. The matching day cell carries aria-selected and a modifier class.

parameters.name: LayoutMode
parameters.description: The layout the scheduler resolved. The ScrollToTime scroll is applied again when it changes, because the first render can precede the container measurement.

examples.title: Timeline with resources
examples.code: <TmSchedulerTimelineView CurrentDate="DateTime.Today" Events="@_events" Resources="@_employees" SlotDuration="60" OnSlotClick="@HandleSlotClick" OnEventClick="@HandleEventClick" OnEventChanged="@HandleEventChanged" />
